speedNotes: Written from Scryfall card data only, before any play results. The common and uncommon creature curve is low and dense (30 two-drops and 32 three-drops), but many cheap creatures carry a second spell through prepare and many spells add loyalty to a Jace token, so games reward card advantage over several turns more than raw speed. Expect boards to stall around turns five to seven unless red decks find noncombat damage or evasive attackers.

mechanics.name: Empower Jace
mechanics.rulesText: Empower Jace N means "Put N loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with '[−1]: Surveil 1' and '[−3]: Draw a card.'" A player has at most one Jace token to empower at a time, and further empower effects add loyalty to it. It appears in every color.
mechanics.reminderText: (Put two loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")

mechanics.name: Prepared
mechanics.rulesText: Prepare cards are creatures with a second, spell face (a sorcery or instant). While the creature is prepared, its controller may cast a copy of that spell, which unprepares the creature. Some creatures enter prepared, some become prepared again at the beginning of each upkeep, and other effects can make a creature prepared or unprepared. Several spell faces are shared by more than one creature.
mechanics.reminderText: (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)

mechanics.name: Surveil
mechanics.rulesText: Surveil N means "Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order." The Jace token's [−1] ability surveils, and many cards reward you whenever you scry or surveil.
mechanics.reminderText: (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

mechanics.name: Prowess
mechanics.rulesText: Prowess is a triggered ability: "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn." Casting a copy of a prepared creature's spell counts.
mechanics.reminderText: (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)

mechanics.name: Flashback
mechanics.rulesText: Flashback [cost] means "You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying [cost] rather than its mana cost. If you do, exile it as it leaves the stack." Several flashback cards do more when cast from a graveyard.
mechanics.reminderText: (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

mechanics.name: Threshold
mechanics.rulesText: Threshold is an ability word. Its abilities work only as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.

mechanics.name: Basic landcycling
mechanics.rulesText: Basic landcycling [cost] means "[cost], Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle." It is a form of typecycling, which is a form of cycling, and appears on one common of each color.
mechanics.reminderText: ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)

mechanics.name: Landfall
mechanics.rulesText: Landfall is an ability word. Its abilities trigger whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control.

mechanics.name: Behold
mechanics.rulesText: To behold a Jace, choose a Jace you control or reveal a Jace card from your hand. It appears as an alternative to an extra cost.
mechanics.reminderText: (To behold a Jace, choose a Jace you control or reveal a Jace card from your hand.)

mechanics.name: Treasure
mechanics.rulesText: A Treasure is an artifact token with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color." It appears only at rare in this set.
mechanics.reminderText: (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

mechanics.name: Cadets
mechanics.rulesText: Many cards create a 2/2 colorless Wizard Soldier creature token named Cadet, and some reward controlling Wizard tokens.

archetypes.name: Scry and Surveil
archetypes.plan: Surveil every turn with prepared spells, Jace tokens, and Cadet makers, and turn each surveil into a team pump or +1/+1 counters while flyers attack.

archetypes.name: Threshold Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Mill yourself to seven cards in the graveyard to turn on threshold, then use flashback and graveyard recursion to win a long game with removal and counters.

archetypes.name: Noncombat Damage
archetypes.plan: Ping the opponent with spells, prepared copies, and attack triggers each turn, which turns on flying, haste, and recursion for creatures that care whether an opponent was dealt noncombat damage.

archetypes.name: Heartwood Ramp
archetypes.plan: Make Heartwood mana artifacts and other mana sources early, then cast big trampling creatures that remove a blocker or add a body when they enter.

archetypes.name: Life Gain and Counters
archetypes.plan: Gain a little life each turn to draw cards and grow creatures, spreading +1/+1 counters that give vigilance and make fights favorable.

archetypes.name: Sacrifice and Recursion
archetypes.plan: Sacrifice creatures and tokens for value, gain life whenever they die, and bring cheap creatures back from the graveyard to do it again.

archetypes.name: Spells and Thopters
archetypes.plan: Cast many noncreature spells, including flashback and prepared copies, to make flying Thopters and trigger prowess, and draw extra cards from spells cast outside your hand.

archetypes.name: Lands in the Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Mill and discard to fill the graveyard, return lands and permanents from it, and use the biggest card there to power removal and threats that come back when they die.

archetypes.name: Counters on Arrival
archetypes.plan: Play creatures and tokens every turn and put +1/+1 counters on the ones that just entered, then use cheap Equipment and team pumps to attack through blockers.

archetypes.name: Jace Planeswalkers
archetypes.plan: Empower a Jace token early and activate a loyalty ability every turn, which untaps attackers and makes them unblockable, then grow creatures from each loyalty counter you add.
